name: Geo. "Shorty" Seltzer
mentions: Geo. Seltzer, son of "Shorty," tore his hand badly in the slaughter-house recently. He slipped and in recovering his balance, grasped the point of a hook that penetrated his hand and…
…k Foster returned from his trip to Chicago and Kansas City, last Thursday night. During his absence, "Shorty" Seltzer has been acting as superintendent of the slaughter-house.
